term: rule content, law representatives and actual instances
definition: An analyst Representation separates bearers B from rule-indexed law-entity candidates R using the disjoint domain B ⊕ R. Ontic presence of each class is supplied independently. ActualInstance requires an existing bearer that instantiates the represented universal. The predicate is not rule truth, a proof term, law selection, or merely a sentence mentioning a law. Distinct indices denote distinct right-summand candidates in this representation; arbitrary overlapping denotation is outside this profile.
note: Logic-first analyst profile for #1109; attribution deferred. Actual metaphysical applicability and any identification with an author's theory remain open. See docs/showcase-naturalism.md §4 and ATTEMPT-NATURALISM-LAW-REPRESENTATIONS-1109.
